theme.description: Serious, reliable, modern, transparent, clear, authoritative. Focuses on data clarity, trust, and validation. Perfect for an ATS optimization tool.
theme.psychology: Instills trust and precision. The lack of visual clutter emphasizes the importance of the data and user control.

typography.rules: Strict hierarchy. Avoid centered text for long forms. Use tight letter spacing for headings.

layout.structure: Mobile-first responsive. Desktop: Sticky vertical sidebar stepper (left) with scrollable main content area (right). Mobile: Horizontal condensed stepper at the top.
layout.spacing: Generous. p-8 for main cards. gap-8 for form sections. Use p-12 for empty states.
layout.grid: Bento-style grids for dashboard/analytics. Mode B (High Density) for ATS Quality report.

components.stepper: Collapsible vertical stepper on desktop. Persist state between steps. Clear numbered labels.
components.diff_view: CSS Grid or Flexbox container for side-by-side (desktop) or stacked (mobile) comparison. Align paired changes in the same row. Do not use independent scroll containers.
components.match_score: Radial progress gauges and horizontal bars for sub-criteria. High contrast.
components.ats_report: Split pane layout. Left: Resume visual. Right: Parsed fields with status chips (Read/Missed).
components.buttons: Solid flat colors with 1px border. Focus states: ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-accent. Pill-shaped or subtle rounded-md.
components.forms: Left-aligned labels. Use Shadcn Input, Textarea. Inline validation errors.
components.checklists: Custom checkbox styles for the 'Missing Skills' confirmation. Emphasize the 'Confirmed by user' state.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders (border-slate-200) for structural division instead of heavy shadows. Use flat, sharp UI.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Soft ambient shadow for floating elements like the Before/After review modal.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in data-heavy areas to maintain clarity. Use only for sticky bottom action bars (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-t border-slate-200).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise on empty state backgrounds to prevent clinical feel.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1. Do not rely solely on color for diffs; use (+)/(-) icons and hidden text labels.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings for keyboard navigation.

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for clean, neutral line icons. Add aria-hidden='true'.

image_urls.description: Woman reading a resume at a table. Can be used for landing page or login screen.
Glasses on a pile of papers. Can be used for ATS/Parsing section background or placeholder.

testing.data_testid: Mandatory on all interactive elements. e.g., data-testid='upload-cv-dropzone', data-testid='accept-diff-button', data-testid='export-pdf-button'.

blocks_instructions.block_1: CV Extraction: Drag and drop zone for PDF/DOCX. Extracted JSON should be presented as an editable form (Identity, Experience, Education, Skills), NOT as a raw JSON string.
blocks_instructions.block_2: Job Offer Analysis: Large textarea for pasting. Display extracted data (Title, Hard/Soft Skills, Keywords) as clear taxonomy chips in a bento grid.
blocks_instructions.block_3: Controlled Generation: Present line-by-line diffs (Before/After) with accept/reject buttons. Missing skills checklist requires explicit user confirmation. Transparent scorecard.
blocks_instructions.block_4: ATS Quality Control: Display Affinda parsing results. Highlight well-read vs poorly-read fields clearly. Alert user if critical data is missing.
blocks_instructions.block_5: Layout & Export: Carousel or grid of 2-3 minimal, ATS-friendly HTML/CSS templates. Mandatory before/after full preview before enabling PDF/DOCX export.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: No generic centered layouts; use clean left-aligned or grid-based structural layouts.
Use 1px borders to separate content instead of over-using cards (Flat Solid surfaces).
Incorporate subtle micro-interactions for button presses and hover states (e.g., -translate-y-px).
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
NEVER use generic placeholder text; use contextual dummy data in French (e.g., 'Développeur Fullstack', 'Paris').
Do not apply global transitions like 'all'. Apply to specific properties.
Always ensure high contrast ratios, especially over colored backgrounds or diff blocks.
The UI is primarily in French. Ensure all static labels, buttons, and placeholders are in French.
Avoid the generic 'Vercel-look'. Customize Shadcn components to feel like a premium, trustworthy tool.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 5-step workflow utilizing a robust state management approach so data persists between steps. The layout should inspire trust (Swiss & High-Contrast). Ensure the Diff UI is built with CSS Grid/Flexbox so it stacks correctly on mobile and aligns line-by-line. Use standard Shadcn UI components and customize spacing, borders, and colors. Do not hallucinate fields. Follow accessibility best practices for the diff view and forms.
